title: Remove Colored Pieces if Both Neighbors are the Same Color
goal: Determine whether Alice wins when only removable same-color interior pieces may be deleted.
strategy: A run of length L supplies max(0,L-2) legal removals to its owner. Removing interior pieces never removes the run endpoints, so the players move budgets are independent.
